mapper.select: WITH candidate AS (SELECT id FROM pf.skill_import_outbox WHERE state='PENDING' OR (state='PUBLISHING' AND relay_until<clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY created_at,id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1) UPDATE pf.skill_import_outbox o SET state='PUBLISHING',relay_owner=#{owner},relay_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '10 seconds' FROM candidate c WHERE o.id=c.id RETURNING o.id,o.space_id,o.import_id,o.generation,o.relay_owner
SELECT space_id FROM pf.space_storage WHERE space_id=#{space} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.skill_import_inbox(event_id,space_id,import_id) VALUES(#{publication.id},#{publication.spaceId},#{publication.importId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.skill_import SET state='RUNNING',owner_id=#{owner},fence=#{fence},lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{publication.importId} AND space_id=#{publication.spaceId} AND generation=#{publication.generation} AND state='QUEUED'

UPDATE pf.skill_import SET lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds' WHERE id=#{command.importId} AND space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{command.actorId} AND state='RUNNING' AND owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND generation=#{command.generation} AND fence=#{command.fence} AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND staging_object_key=#{command.objectKey} AND declared_bytes=#{command.bytes} AND declared_sha256=#{command.sha256}

UPDATE pf.skill_import SET state=#{state},error_code=#{reason},owner_id=NULL,fence=NULL,lease_until=NULL,revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{command.importId} AND space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{command.actorId} AND state='RUNNING' AND owner_id=#{command.ownerId} AND generation=#{command.generation} AND fence=#{command.fence} AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND staging_object_key=#{command.objectKey} AND declared_bytes=#{command.bytes} AND declared_sha256=#{command.sha256}
UPDATE pf.skill_import_reservation SET state='RECONCILING',revision=revision+1 WHERE import_id=#{command.importId} AND space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND state='RESERVED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.capability(id,space_id,owner_user_id,kind) VALUES(#{row.targetCapabilityId},#{row.spaceId},#{row.ownerUserId},'SKILL') ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM pf.capability WHERE id=#{id} AND space_id=#{space} AND owner_user_id=#{actor} AND kind='SKILL' FOR UPDATE
SELECT coalesce(max(version_number),0)+1 FROM pf.capability_version WHERE space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND capability_id=#{row.targetCapabilityId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.skill_package_version(space_id,owner_user_id,capability_id,version_id,asset_id,archive_bytes,archive_sha256, expanded_bytes,file_count,name,description,manifest,dependency_manifest) VALUES(#{row.spaceId},#{row.ownerUserId},#{row.targetCapabilityId},#{row.targetVersionId},#{row.targetAssetId},#{row.declaredBytes},#{row.declaredSha256}, #{expanded},#{fileCount},#{name},#{description},CAST(#{manifest} AS jsonb),CAST(#{dependencies} AS jsonb))
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.space_storage s SET reserved_bytes=s.reserved_bytes-r.bytes,committed_bytes=s.committed_bytes+r.bytes,version=s.version+1 FROM pf.skill_import_reservation r WHERE r.import_id=#{command.importId} AND r.space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND r.space_id=s.space_id AND r.state='RESERVED' AND s.reserved_bytes>=r.bytes
UPDATE pf.skill_import_reservation SET state='SETTLED',revision=revision+1 WHERE import_id=#{command.importId} AND space_id=#{command.spaceId} AND state='RESERVED'
